name: Pressurised deaerators
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Feedtank 85-90 C gives about 2 mg/L oxygen; pressurised deaerator 0.2 bar g / 105 C, 10-20 min storage, water supply at least 2 bar, steam 5-10 bar, about 5:1 turndown, vent 0.5-2 kg per 1,000 kg/h capacity; feedwater pH at least 8.5-9; high-pressure boilers need oxygen typically below 7 ppb. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/pressurised-deaerators?sc_lang=en-GB
